d:
Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight-cut bangs and a silky texture. Sharp, narrow deep amethyst eyes with a haughty, regal expression. Apparent age is early twenties with a mature, sophisticated demeanor. Slender and graceful build. A voluminous, multi-layered gothic lolita dress in a palette of deep black and stark white, featuring a large bow and intricate lace ruffles. Signature details include a floating, massive black and white mechanical rigging system with oversized gothic ornaments behind the back.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain skin
